about: lzpack's application mutants (corpus wave HP2): edits of the example that its laws and cases judge, and edits that keep every stream valid, which only TestLzpackAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (the seeded property against the plain reference and the hand Go control) sees.

mutants.name: lzpack-match-reaches-past-window
mutants.rule: A match starts fewer than Window bytes back, so its offset fits the format's 16 bits and a decoder needs only a Window of history.

mutants.name: lzpack-literals-past-stream-end
mutants.rule: Literals that the stream does not hold are Truncated, a typed failure, never a slice past the end (a defect).

mutants.name: lzpack-offset-before-output
mutants.rule: A copy from offset 0 or from before the first byte is BadOffset. The ring makes such a read no defect, so only the agreement with Walk and with the control sees it.

mutants.name: lzpack-copy-past-block
mutants.rule: A copy that runs past its block's raw length is Overrun.

mutants.name: lzpack-match-positions-not-chained
mutants.rule: Every earlier position whose four bytes are in the input is in a chain, so the parse is the format's: a stream that skips them is valid but not the one the control and the reference write.

mutants.name: lzpack-older-equal-match-wins
mutants.rule: Of equal matches the newest wins (the shortest offset).

mutants.name: lzpack-block-limit-off-by-one
mutants.rule: A block holds at most BlockMax raw bytes; a header of BlockMax+1 is BlockTooLong.
